desc: Rebirth - player character can restart character at 1st level with same memories but with no abilities
Buy specialist skill of own character class not already acquired. May be bought only once per skill.
+1 Max AC (Max 12) when wearing Master Crafted Armour. This is cumulative with other max AC increases up to max AC 12.
Immunity to Alignment Change except through Spiritual Mastery - half cost (20pts) for Paladins and Unholy Champions
Large Lung Capacity - Character can hold their breath for up to 5 minutes.

Psionic Sensitive - Character gains Psionic Sensitivity, as the Monk skill, but takes double effect from the first incoming neuronic attack of each five minutes, and may not apply defences against it.

Disease Resistance - Character cannot die from any disease, and suffers ½ effect or progression rate from all diseases. This resistance is gained from a chronic childhood illness that leaves the character permanently and incurably down 4 life to the chest and 2 to all other body locations.
Sensitive Smell - Character gains the Discern Smell ability but takes double effect from olfactory attacks. This ability is lost if the character ever acquires Immunity to Olfactory Attacks.

Emotional Sensitive - Character may utilise a physical Psi-Scan 1/day (no casting damage applies). Ability is lost if the character becomes immune to emotional attacks, and the points spent on it are wasted.

Trusty Old Weapon - The first non-"item" weapon (of type specified when ability bought) that the character begins the adventure with is immune to Shatter, Rust, Melt, Disintegrate, Warp, and similar as if supernatural until the end of the adventure. If this weapon is somehow destroyed or lost before the end of the adventure, the character gains zero achievement points for the mission (but gains a new weapon for the next adventure).

Good Memory for Names - Character can remember any name they have been told perfectly, and may ask the referee to repeat any name from the adventure brief at any reasonable and relevant time! Does not apply to remembering anything but names.
Natural Athlete - As Salmon Leap 1/day.

Vigilante - Character gains Discern Outlaw at will and a 25% rage 1/day vs. outlaws only. Discern Outlaw will reveal the degree of outlawing (e.g. outlaw, ostracised, wolfshead.) If the character finds an outlaw, they must attempt to bring them in alive (or dead; but only if the outlaw attacks the character or his party) to the local legal authority to meet justice for their crimes. If they do not, they suffer a permanent irremovable curse of conscience (as curse in the handbook, but physical in origin which fades only when the character successfully brings in his next outlaw) and gain zero points for the mission.
Enhanced Reflexes: Grants +1 (total) DAC.
Burst of Strength - 1/day for 5 minutes character gains +1 stackable Strength (max. +3!), but for 15 minutes afterwards is reduced to a maximum of +0 Strength.

Sensitive Hearing - Character gains the Acute Hearing ability but takes double effect from sonic attacks, and may never talk louder than a whisper (this will prevent the character from casting certain spells or miracles, such as Restore Life or Touch of Death, or use abilities such as Ki Shouts, War-Cries, etc). This ability is lost if the character ever acquires Immunity to Sonic Attacks.
Stubbornness - Character gains immunity to Listed Stopping Effects 1/day for 5 minutes but will never willingly retreat from a foe at any time, regardless of danger.
Natural Climbing Skills - As Assisted Climb 1/day.

Superstitious Nature - Character may not use any form of magic spell, innate ability or item, but may sense magic 20' radius at will (Yes/No answer, not locational) and gains +1 MAC. Character is feared for 5 minutes if directly attacked by visible magic, to which Immunity to Fear does not apply.
Lucky Idea - 1/day gains a minor informational insight into a single issue, physical in origin, with the exact information revealed completely at the discretion of the referee.
Psionic Retardation - Character gains Mind Block (as Monk), but may not buy any neuronic power, or even utilise neuronics from items.

Toxin Resistance - Character's advanced immune system duplicates the effects of Ant Venom 6 in his system once each hour and character falls unconscious for 5 minutes rather than dying from death poison. Character takes ½ effect from all beneficial ingestive potions.

Ancient Blessing - Gains a Fortified Spirit and Immunity to Slayer and like abilities, but dies permanently if they do anything or convinces another to do anything that would permanently slay anyone, including raising as undead.

Fated Hero - will succeed any TOD survival roll, if there is any chance at all of success (still costs res chance as normal). Restore Life type effects performed off dungeon cost 10% less (to a minimum of 10%)

Stockiness - Character gains Resistance to Sever/Location to Zero as per Table 3, but dies if any location is severed due to damage. Dwarves with this quirk are knocked unconscious by any location being reduced to 0 LOC or below.

Bound to the City - The character is bound to the chosen city as one of their Kallah. They gain Kallah benefits as per Kallah beggar. However they may not belong to Social or Political guilds as their only loyalties are to the city

Brute - Character is very stupid (akin to ½ Ogre intelligence) and may not cast any form of supernatural effect, including spells, miracles, neuronics, earthpower or ki powers even from items. Character gains +1 stackable Strength (max. +2),+6/2 life and +1 innate PAC.

Animal Friend - Character will not attack normal (not giant) animals save in purest self-defence, and will encourage others not to do so. No normal animal will attack the character save in self-defence.

Paranoia - Character is incurably insane, and gains Sixth Sense, Traitor's Shield and Discern Poison skill. Character may not join any guilds, and automatically leaves those he is currently in. Character will not willingly accept aid from anyone, trusting only themselves and their divine patron, if they have one.

Megalomania - Character gains +2 resistance levels to Domination effects, but is incurably insane. Due to lack of grip upon reality, character may not join any political guild, and automatically leaves any he is currently in
Naturally Suspicious - Character gains the Streetwise skill and Sixth Sense, but is a bit of a social outcast and thus cannot join any social guild, and automatically leaves any he is currently in.
1st extra level of tblp/loc, take able only once on this table (grants max of 1 +5/2). This is calculated based on the character's class with the highest life scale that can buy this ability.
Weapon Mastery of one weapon - class is proficient with. May be bought only once per weapon.
Enhanced reflexes +2 (total) from +1

Noble Family's Retainer - The noble family in question must be written on the card when the ability is acquired, and the family's head must countersign the ability. Such a retainer gains +1 level of resistance to domination effects not cast by a member of the family, but looses 1 level of resistance to ALL effects cast by a member of the family. Benign supernatural effects cast by a family member, if the family is ' Of the Blood' either have their duration increased by 50% or if the effect is numeric, grant a 50% increase in effect. In addition, if on adventure with a member of the family who possesses an immunity to a particular type of informational spell/miracle/neuronics or evocation, or other informational effects, then the Retainer is also so protected. Should the Retainer leave a family member behind on an adventure, and was not instructed to leave the adventure by a family member, the retainer suffers a permanent loss of 2pts of Dexterity Armour Class until forgiven by the abandoned Noble. Should a Family member leave a retainer behind on an adventure, and were not instructed to leave by another (senior) family member, then the family member suffers the loss of DAC as detailed above until forgiven by the retainer.
